description: This file defines a utility enum GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport with static methods to manage gateway selection and configuration, including choosing preferred transport, applying remote selections, and checking host suffixes based on gateway details.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Configures the AppState with the preferred remote transport and gateway URL and target based on the discovered gateway.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines the preferred transport type for a given gateway, defaulting to current if no direct preference is detected.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Decides whether to prefer direct transport over other options based on gateway URL presence and hostname suffix.
